The video cuts to a mechanic in a service bay installing a spare tire on a vehicle, then returns to the presenter. The segment concludes with a visual comparison showing “Good Tread” versus “Bad Tread” on tires, emphasizing the importance of proper tire condition.

A GMC Certified Service technician presents a vehicle maintenance guide, using visual aids to demonstrate tire tread condition and the recommended 7,500-mile rotation interval, emphasizing the importance of regular tire care for vehicle safety and performance.

This segment provides a GMC tire maintenance tutorial, demonstrating how to check tire tread depth. It begins by contrasting “Good Tread” and “Bad Tread” visuals, then shows a hand using a tread depth gauge and a penny as a simple, DIY method to assess wear. The segment concludes with a GMC-certified service technician speaking in front of a GMC truck, reinforcing the brand’s recommended maintenance schedule of rotating tires every 7,500 miles.
